questions.question: Giddha is the folk dance of _____.
questions.solution:
Giddha is a popular folk dance of Punjab, performed exclusively by women.
  • Nature: It is a lively dance performed during festive or social occasions, especially during the harvest.
  • Performance: Women form a circle and clap in rhythm while singing small couplets called Boliyan.
  • Costume: Dancers wear traditional bright-colored Salwar Kameez and heavy jewelry.
Note: While Giddha is for women, Bhangra is the corresponding energetic folk dance traditionally performed by men in Punjab.

questions.question: Raas-Leela symbolises which classical dance based on the spiritual and eternal love of Radha and Krishna?
questions.solution:
Raas-Leela is the core theme of the Manipuri classical dance, representing the divine love between Radha and Krishna.
  • Origin: This dance form originated in the northeastern state of Manipur.
  • Features: It is characterized by gentle, lyrical, and fluid movements. The dancers wear a unique stiff, barrel-shaped skirt called a Kumil.
  • Spiritual Context: Unlike other dance forms that may have secular themes, Manipuri is deeply rooted in Vaishnavism.

questions.question: Which dance form has evolved since the 19th century under the patronage of King Swathi Thirunal of Travancore?
questions.solution:
Mohiniyattam received significant patronage and was further refined in the 19th century by King Swathi Thirunal of the Travancore Royal Family.
  • Meaning: The word translates to the 'Dance of the Enchantress' (Mohini is a feminine avatar of Lord Vishnu).
  • Style: It is a solo dance performed by women, known for its swaying movements like the palm trees of Kerala.
  • Costume: Dancers typically wear a white or off-white saree with a gold-colored brocade (Kasavu) border.

questions.question: In which year did Kathak dancer and guru from Ujjain, Puru Dadheech receive the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for his overall contribution to the performing arts?
questions.solution:
Pandit Puru Dadheech, a distinguished Kathak dancer, choreographer, and scholar from Ujjain, was honored with the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2018.
  • Contribution: He is known for his extensive research into the Shastric (scriptural) traditions of Kathak and is a pioneer in the formal education of dance.
  • Legacy: He is often credited with reviving the ancient temple-style compositions within the Kathak repertoire.

questions.question: Which of the following classical dance forms belongs to Northern India?
questions.solution:
Kathak is the only classical dance form that originated in Northern India (specifically Uttar Pradesh).
  • Etymology: The word comes from 'Katha', meaning storyteller.
  • Features: It is famous for its intricate footwork (Tatkar) and fast pirouettes (Chakkars).
  • Gharanas: Major schools of Kathak include Lucknow, Jaipur, and Banaras gharanas.
Additional Note: Kuchipudi is from Andhra Pradesh, while Kathakali and Mohiniyattam are both from Kerala.

questions.question: Who was conferred a gold medal in 1968 by the Mexican government for her choreography?
questions.solution:
Mrinalini Sarabhai was an iconic classical dancer who was awarded a gold medal by the Mexican Government in 1968 for her choreography of the ballet 'The Song of Creation'.
  • Expertise: She was an exponent of both Bharatanatyam and Kathakali.
  • Institution: She founded the Darpana Academy of Performing Arts in Ahmedabad.
Note: She was the wife of the famous space scientist Vikram Sarabhai.

questions.question: To which state of India does swimmer Srihari Nataraj belong?
questions.solution:
Srihari Nataraj is a prominent Indian swimmer who hails from the state of Karnataka.
  • Achievements: He represented India at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics and has won multiple gold medals at the South Asian Games.
  • Specialty: He is primarily known for his performance in backstroke events.

questions.question: Kalamandalam Kshemavathy Pavithran, recipient of Padma Shri and a performer of mohiniyattam, belongs to which of the following states of India?
questions.solution:
Kalamandalam Kshemavathy is a legendary performer of Mohiniyattam from Kerala.
  • Training: As her name suggests, she was trained at the prestigious Kerala Kalamandalam, a center for the preservation of Kerala's traditional arts.
  • Recognition: She was awarded the Padma Shri in 2011 for her lifelong dedication to the classical arts.

questions.question: निम्नलिखित में से किस नर्तक/नर्तकी को 2018 में छऊ नृत्य के लिए संगीत नाटक अकादमी पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया?
questions.solution:
तपन कुमार पट्टनायक (Tapan Kumar Pattanayak) को 2018 में छऊ (Chhau) नृत्य में उनके योगदान के लिए संगीत नाटक अकादमी पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया।
  • छऊ नृत्य: यह एक अर्ध-शास्त्रीय भारतीय नृत्य है जिसमें मार्शल आर्ट, आदिवासी और लोक परंपराएं शामिल हैं।
  • प्रकार: इसके तीन मुख्य रूप हैं—सरायकेला (झारखंड), मयूरभंज (ओडिशा), और पुरुलिया (पश्चिम बंगाल)।
  • विशेषता: मयूरभंज छऊ में मुखौटों का उपयोग नहीं किया जाता, जबकि अन्य दो रूपों में मुखौटे अनिवार्य हैं।

questions.question: In which state is the Nandi Award for the best choreographer presented every year?
questions.solution:
The Nandi Awards are the highest excellence awards in Andhra Pradesh for cinema, television, and theater, which includes a category for Best Choreographer.
  • Context: Named after the Nandi Bull at the Lepakshi temple, these awards recognize achievements in the Telugu cultural industry.
  • Significance: Winning a Nandi award is considered a prestigious milestone for technicians and artists in the region.

questions.question: The Sangeet Natak Akademi Award carries a purse money of __________, in addition to a Angavastram and Tamrapatra.
questions.solution:
The Sangeet Natak Akademi Award includes a cash prize of ₹1,00,000 (one lakh rupees).
  • Components: Along with the money, the awardee receives an Angavastram (shawl) and a Tamrapatra (brass plaque/citation).
  • Sangeet Natak Akademi: It is the highest national recognition given to practicing artists in the fields of music, dance, and drama.
